title: HumanCentric-Scenes-AI: A Human-Curated Multimodal Dataset of AI-Generated Human-Centric Scenes Across Surveillance, Occupational Portraits, AI-Edited Images, and Short-Form Video

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting a text-to-image generator with gender-neutral occupational prompts (using both explicit occupation names and descriptive roles) and comparing the depicted gender distribution of the generated images against U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) occupational gender shares to measure stereotype congruence and default male bias.
